installer.description: Official Git for Windows installer, newest release resolved at install time

installer-pinned.description: Official Git for Windows installer, pinned release

aiPrompts.versionDiscovery: Check https://git-scm.com for latest Git version. The Windows 'installer' variant resolves the newest Git for Windows release at install time from the GitHub releases of git-for-windows/git (versionResolver: git-for-windows).
aiPrompts.urlResolution: Linux uses package managers. Windows: winget (Git.Git), chocolatey (git) or the official installer from https://git-scm.com/install/windows — release assets Git-{version}-64-bit.exe (x64) and Git-{version}-arm64.exe (arm64) under https://github.com/git-for-windows/git/releases/download/v{tag-version}.windows.{n}/ (asset version is e.g. 2.56.0.2 for tag v2.56.0.windows.2).
aiPrompts.updateGuidance: Git updates regularly with security fixes. On Windows the default variant follows available tooling: winget, then chocolatey, then the official installer. 'installer' tracks the newest release automatically and falls back to 'installer-pinned' when GitHub cannot be reached, so keep 'installer-pinned' current: bump version, both urls (x64, arm64) and both sha256 checksums (digest of each release asset).
